Name: (CP) Better Fertilizer Recipes
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
The recipes for the fertilizers are a bit inconsistent -  both of the other speed grow recipes give you 5 fertilizer for the recipe, but the one that costs the most doesn't (how odd).

And the retaining soil starts off following the basic fertilizer convention (1 - 2 - 5 for the recipes) and then just hops back down to 1 instead of giving you 5 for it...

So I changed both :) 



Kudos to the old mod that changes the hyper speed-gro recipe [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11079?tab=files]Here[/url]﻿ - I made my own code for my mod though :)

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b]

Manifest.Name: Better Fertilizer Recipes
Manifest.Description: Increases the amount of fertilizer given from the high tier recipes to 5.
